methods.description: Exact source IDs/names/tiers matched against scoped current features; parent membership and settlement limits assessed against retained official administrative tables.
methods.software: Python 3; Node.js 24.19.0; pandas/xlrd for spreadsheets as recorded in packet scripts

methods.description: Reprojected polygon overlays, unions, components, intersections, candidate areas and nearest-component distances; source geometry retained unchanged.
methods.area_method: Planar area in EPSG:6933; percentages use source feature area; union symmetric difference divided by current union area.
methods.distance_method: Euclidean distance between nearest projected geometry points in EPSG:6933; screening only.

conclusions.text: The scoped 144 current location IDs resolve uniquely in the pinned baseline and all have complete five-level parent chains; this is structural evidence, not a regional approval.
Pinned administrative source crosswalks identify the stated unit names, years and tier differences; they do not determine shared boundaries or political ownership.
Madagascar COD-AB exposes an extra district and material source/current overlay and disconnected component differences; needs coordinated follow-up and source validation.
Current retained evidence does not provide exhaustive geocoded settlement coverage for all assigned islands and administrative units.
Source granularity and island/shoreline detections do not settle all physically disconnected territory or shared regional boundaries.
